rules.positive: round 2's frozen curvature-screened positive (the anchor's direct partner)
rules.negative: an item that already shares the anchor L1 code in the frozen TIGER export and has no observed training-graph relation with the anchor; a seeded uniform pick over the candidates sorted by item id
rules.negative_refresh: the trainer re-mines the same rule from the current assignment every HARDNEG_REFRESH_EPOCHS epochs (the rule is frozen; only the partition it reads changes)
rules.curvature_role: offline selection of the positive inside the comparability group only; the curvature never enters the loss, the margin or a weight
rules.false_negative_note: the negative is a measured false positive in the frozen export, not a proof of behavioural irrelevance
